title: VDBE statement explain-mode transition

scope.rationale: sqlite3_stmt_explain is the stateful boundary that validates mode changes, chooses in-place reuse versus reprepare, records EQP-op availability, and publishes the mode-specific result-column shape.
excluded_responsibilities: Public bounded Statement ownership and exported ABI dispatch

external_source_responsibilities: Source sqlite3Reprepare compilation, operation swap, and binding transfer
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete mode-transition body is assigned. Reprepare is a named injected source boundary until the native prepare owner is integrated.

inputs: Nullable source-layout Vdbe, requested explain mode 0 through 2, and the native reprepare operation
outputs: MISUSE, ERROR, BUSY, or the reprepare result with explain, haveEqpOps, and nResColumn updated as source specifies
contracts.ownership: No allocation ownership changes locally. Reprepare retains responsibility for replacing bytecode and preserving statement-owned SQL and bindings.
contracts.state_and_results: Equal mode is a no-op; invalid or unsaved-SQL modes return ERROR; running statements return BUSY; reusable programs switch in place; smaller/EQP-incomplete programs reprepare. Result columns are 8 for EXPLAIN, 4 for EQP, and nResAlloc otherwise.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: The connection mutex spans validation, optional reprepare, and result-column publication. The injected reprepare operation represents the source compiler call. No direct I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Validation failures preserve explain mode. A reprepare result is returned after source-compatible explain and haveEqpOps publication, permitting the caller to inspect/reset the statement.

representation_differences: The direct sqlite3Reprepare call is represented by a named function pointer so the exact mode-transition owner can be translated before the native prepare subsystem is integrated.
C bitfields use the exact VdbeFlags representation; mode and result-column arithmetic use explicit Zig casts after source range validation.

oracle.protocol: The shared VDBE builder worker will compare same-mode, invalid-mode, missing-SAVESQL, busy, EXPLAIN, and EQP transitions. Pinned C uses public sqlite3_stmt_explain on a prepared SELECT; Zig uses an exact source-layout Vdbe with a counted reprepare operation.
internal_observations: result code, explain mode, and result-column count
oracle.normalization: Prepared-program addresses and bytecode are not compared; mode-transition state and callback count are exact.

assurance.oom: No local allocation; reprepare OOM remains owned by the prepare subsystem.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; the source connection mutex scope is retained.
assurance.malformed_input: Null statement, out-of-range mode, missing saved SQL, and running-state validation are explicit.
assurance.continuation: Validation failures preserve the old mode; successful transitions publish a self-consistent result-column count.
assurance.performance: Constant-time in-place path; reprepare cost is delegated exactly when source requires it.

integration.native_call_path: The pinned-C/public-prepare and source-layout-Zig worker paths compare exact transition state; native sqlite3Reprepare integration remains pending.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Exported sqlite3_stmt_explain still uses the bounded Statement owner.

independent_review.notes: Requires native reprepare/public statement integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Integrate native sqlite3Reprepare and switch exported statement ownership.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeapi.c:2037-2087 was reviewed completely for adjacent query APIs, the full sqlite3_stmt_explain body, mutex scope, mode validation, reprepare selection, EQP state, and result-column arithmetic
src/core/internal/vdbe_api.zig statement metadata and src/core/internal/vdbe_types.zig exact Vdbe fields were reviewed with the current prepare boundary
callers: The public sqlite3_stmt_explain API is the sole direct caller
Statement metadata consumers read explain/nResColumn after transition
Exported bounded Statement ownership remains outside this unit
callees: Connection mutex enter/leave protects the complete transition
sqlite3Reprepare is called only when nMem or EQP-op availability prevents in-place reuse
The translated named reprepare operation preserves that call boundary without claiming compiler integration
assertions_branches_cleanup: All seven active behavior IDs cover null armor, equal/invalid/unsaved/busy/reusable/reprepare paths, result-column publication, and return
haveEqpOps changes only on the reprepare path and records whether mode 2 was requested
Every non-null path leaves the connection mutex exactly once
upstream_tests: Upstream stmt-explain, explain, EQP, schema/reprepare, misuse, busy, and API armor tests exercise this boundary
Project source-layout VDBE builder differential compares same/invalid/busy/unsaved/EXPLAIN/EQP transitions within a 398-observation trace
